organization.name: Action For India
organization.tagline: A Platform to Help Scale High-Potential Social Entrepreneurs
organization.mission_statement: Action For India's mission is to help high potential social entrepreneurs overcome barriers to scale and achieve greater impact at the bottom of the pyramid.
organization.mission_goal: Our intent is to create 25 Impact Unicorns by the year 2025. AFI believes that Impact Unicorns have the potential to positively impact at least a million lives with sustainable revenues over a 5-year period. In this context, our mission is to identify and help scale at least 25 of such Social Enterprises to be Unicorns and in the process, potentially enhance the lives of 25 Million people.
organization.vision: AFI strongly believes in the philosophy that sustainable human development can happen only by empowering high-potential social entrepreneurs and creating conditions to enable their success.
organization.social_enterprise_definition: Any organization that is developing products and services that proactively make things better for those in the under-served communities and attempts to do it at scale.
organization.un_alignment: AFI Strongly mirrors the United Nations philosophy that Human Development can happen sustainably only by enhancing human abilities and creating conditions to enable development. In line with the UN Sustainable Development Goals.
organization.description_footer: Action For India (AFI) is a platform to help scale high-potential social entrepreneurs. AFI provides access to capital via our relationships with foundations and funding institutions. It also helps social entrepreneurs benefit from the diverse experience of our best-in-class mentors working across industries globally. AFI helps maximize entrepreneurs' potential through high-impact technology support from Silicon Valley experts and also access to a cohesive network of the Indian diaspora.

testimonials.quote: I think AFI is playing an extremely important role in terms of bridging the gap for social enterprises and organizations supporting them; thereby developing the ecosystem for a better tomorrow.
testimonials.name: SOMBHODI GHOSH
testimonials.title: Co-founder, Aakar Innovations

testimonials.quote: After the AFI event held in Aug 2013, where we met 46 IAS Officers, we got invited by the District Administration of Mayurbhanj district, Odisha to replicate our work in Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu. We have now entered a very exciting phase that combines the scale of the Government and the speed and efficiency of the private sector. I sincerely thank AFI for making this happen.

testimonials.title: Managing Director & CEO, Arohana Dairy Private Limited

testimonials.quote: AFI has been a key support network in our scale up journey, from great sessions and exposure during the forum in 2019 to the very in depth sessions during silicon valley trek. We thank Mr. Sanjay Kadaveru for taking keen interest individually in our journey.
testimonials.name: SUKHMEET SINGH
testimonials.title: Founder & CEO, A2P Energy Solution Pvt. Ltd.

testimonials.quote: Being a part of AFI made me realize I am not lonely in this long yet adventurous journey. The insights I obtained from the Forum have helped me redefine many aspects of my business. I have a better perspective of who my beachhead market is and how to reach them. The friends I made at the forum, inspire me to create a greater impact with each passing day. AFI gives me great hope vis-a-vis the socio-economic development of India as I look forward to being at the Forum again soon.
testimonials.name: ABHIMANYU RATHI
testimonials.title: Co-Founder & CEO, SLII

testimonials.quote: AFI organizes the best social enterprise conference I know of in India, curating the 100 best social enterprises from across the country.

annual_forum.description: Our annual forum is a keenly anticipated event bringing together social enterprises with the entire ecosystem of industry leaders, investors, government and technology experts. The event showcases groundbreaking ideas and exceptional work done by our social entrepreneurs besides enabling them to network and get recognised. The forum is also a meeting ground where dialogues enable consolidation of possible insights for policy making.

journey_timeline.event: Action For India (AFI) took shape to help Social Entrepreneurs enable sustainable social impact. The first AFI Annual Forum enabled the coming together of high potential entrepreneurs, mentors and startup advisors.
Leveraged Indian Diaspora which helped begin AFI's US Silicon Valley Chapter. The Kakatiya Sandbox Network program in Telangana was undertaken in partnership with the Deshpande Foundation.
Launched the Silicon Valley Challenge (SVC) Trek - an immersive, experiential learning program for Social Entrepreneurs.
Expansion of Sandbox Network to Varanasi with the launch of Ek Soch Sandbox in partnership with Spice Connect.
Achieved the milestone of establishing a strong network of 500 social entrepreneurs across various sectors.
Initiated long-term collaboration with NITI Aayog for the AFI Forum.
Established a blueprint for programs to address the changing needs of social entrepreneurs, especially women entrepreneurs, to play a more direct role in the scaling journey of the entrepreneurs.
Launched the AFI i-TIC Foundation Social Entrepreneurship Accelerator (AISEA) in partnership with IIT Hyderabad.

AFI is on the threshold of evolution and is entering new territories of Advisory services, launched the UK Chapter of AFI, started partnership with eBay to facilitate growth of women entrepreneurship.

faqs.question: What stage should my startup be in?
faqs.answer: Early to growth-stage startups with a working MVP or product.

faqs.question: Is this a virtual program?
faqs.answer: Yes, with optional field immersion in key agri regions.

faqs.question: What is the cost to join?
faqs.answer: Free. AFI takes no fees or equity.

faqs.question: What sectors qualify under Agri-tech for impact?
faqs.answer: Precision farming, market access, FPO platforms, water/soil tech, agri-finance, and more.

faqs.question: Who are the mentors?
faqs.answer: Agri-entrepreneurs, investors, former bureaucrats, and innovation leaders.

faqs.question: What happens at the end of the cohort?
faqs.answer: A Demo Day + potential access to investor and pilot partnerships.

items.title: LoveLocal Raises $18m in one of the largest rounds ever raised by a Solo Woman Tech Founder in India
items.excerpt: MUMBAI, India, Oct. 28, 2021 /PRNewswire/ -- LoveLocal, India's leading hyper-local e-commerce platform empowering local retailers, has raised $18m or INR 143 crores, in a Pre-Series B investment round that features some of the most prominent investors and founders globally. The round, which was oversubscribed, is led by Vulcan Capital, and also includes participation from Klarna Founder & CEO Seb

items.title: AFI-SVC Trek Fellow, Sandith Thandasherry, launches his first book
items.excerpt: AFI’s partner organisation and SVC Trek 2017 Fellow, Mr. Sandith Thandasherry, CEO, NavAlt Solar and Electric Boats, recently launched the first edition of his book "Solar-Electric Boat - Plan, Build and Benefit". The book targets the marine transport system’s decision makers, advisors and team, who need to understand the fundamentals of solar-electric boats.

items.title: Organisation building assistive tech solutions wins the ‘Most Impactful Assistive Technology (AT) Start-Up'
items.excerpt: Trestle Labs, an ex-AFI fellow organisation providing solutions for the visually impaired through assistive technology and learning has just won ‘Most Impactful Assistive Technology (AT) Start-up' by AssisTech Foundation Awards. The organisation has been receiving mentorship from Lavni Ventures for over a year and is in talks for investment currently.

items.excerpt: Nemocare Wellness working (healthcare) and AGNEXT (agriculture) have been selected for this years' Google Startups Accelerator Program. items.title: AFI Fellow, Newndra Innovations Private Wins National Intellectual Property Awards for Year 2020
items.excerpt: Mr. Ganesh Ram Jangir, AFI fellow & founder of Newndra Innovations Pvt. Ltd. has been selected as the winner of National Intellectual Property Awards for the Year 2020 in the category 'Top Start-up for IT and commercialisation'. Due to the pandemic, the ceremony will be held online & the award will be given by Hon'ble Minister of Commerce and Industry, Shri Piyush Goyal.

items.title: AFI Fellow, Sohum Innovation Labs won a grant of ₹2,500,000 from Prosus SICA
items.excerpt: Three Indian startups are working to scale up assistive tech for differently-abled backed by new funding received as part of the inaugural Prosus Social Impact Challenge for Accessibility (Prosus SICA). Sohum won for its "highly accessible device” that has been designed to detect hearing impairment amongst infants and small children.

items.title: GUVI makes it into the Guinness World Records For it's 'AI-for-India 1.0' initiative
items.excerpt: AFI's partner organisation GUVI, received the Guinness World Records for it's 'AI-for-India 1.0' initiative that had the most number of users to take computer programming lessons in 24 hours. GUVI is an online platform to learn computer programming and coding in India, which offers free and paid classes in multiple languages.

items.title: AFI Fellow, Doctors For You, making oxygen available at the Peak of COVID-19
items.excerpt: The Hero Group, in collaboration with an NGO called Doctors for You, founded by AFI fellow, have made 100 oxygen concentrators available along with medicines and doctors in Haryana to help fight the pandemic.

items.title: AFI WISEpreneur Neha Kirpal - Enhance Outreach through Industry Partnerships
items.excerpt: AFI's WISEpreneur Neha Kirpal, Co-Founder of the mental health platform Innerhour, stressed upon enhancing the outreach by partnering with other organizations during her interaction with the investors/advisors in the UK Chapter Meeting.
